pkgmetadata.longdescription:
ast-grep searches and rewrites code by matching the abstract syntax tree rather than lines of text, so a pattern like `foo($A)` matches the call however it is wrapped or indented, and ignores the same text inside a comment or string. It supports many languages through tree-sitter and can apply rewrites in bulk, which makes it a codemod tool as much as a search tool.
Upstream also installs the binary under the short name `sg`. This package does not, because `sg` is already a command from sys-apps/shadow.
